_comment: Local Oracle MCP server, copied from the backend project's governance/mcp-servers/oracle.
Talks to the local throwaway test database LOAN_SYS@localhost:1521/FREEPDB1 (the erp-oracle container)
through node-oracledb thin mode. READ-ONLY here (SELECT / WITH, enforced by SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY):
schema changes go through Flyway, never through this server. Run `npm install` once in governance/mcp-servers/oracle.
Export ORACLE_PASSWORD (the local test schema's password) in your shell before starting Claude Code; it is never stored in this file.
